attacks.claim: The subject-matter and territorial rules of the items on bankruptcy and companies and on intellectual property of the article it names stay in force until the specialised poles are installed. | partly: The TEXT cites Article 40(3) and (4), but does not identify their subjects as bankruptcy/company disputes and intellectual property.
The plaintiff may not raise the plea of territorial incompetence. | partly: The TEXT does not identify «هذا الدفع» as a plea of territorial incompetence.

For the social section, the court of the place where the employment contract was made or performed, or of the defendant's domicile, has jurisdiction. | partly: The TEXT does not say that this rule applies to the social section.

For the real-property section, the court where the property lies has jurisdiction, unless the law provides otherwise. | partly: The TEXT does not identify the real-property section as the section to which this rule applies.

Claims in the matters listed after it are brought before the courts named there; the paragraph does not use the words of exclusivity used in the next article. | partly: The TEXT does not show that the next article uses exclusivity wording.
The request for an order to pay is made to the president of the court of the debtor's domicile. | partly: The TEXT does not identify the creditor's petition as a request for an order to pay.

The paragraphs of the code's article on the composition of the court that created the specialised poles are repealed. | partly: The TEXT does not say that Article 32 concerns the court's composition or that its repealed paragraphs created specialised poles.

Territorial jurisdiction of the administrative courts follows the rules on the defendant's domicile and on several defendants. | partly: The TEXT cites Articles 37 and 38 without stating their rules on the defendant's domicile and several defendants.

The subject of the dispute may be changed by incidental requests connected with the original claims. | partly: The TEXT does not identify the object referred to by «تعديله» as the subject of the dispute.

The judge may give way of his own motion when he finds that the same dispute is pending elsewhere. | partly: The TEXT says «إذا تبين له وحدة الموضوع» but does not state that the same dispute is pending before another court.

Besides the rules on the defendant's domicile, several defendants and voluntary appearance, claims in the matters listed after it are brought before the courts named there and no other. | partly: The TEXT does not state that Articles 37, 38 and 46 concern the defendant's domicile, several defendants and voluntary appearance.

Liability claims for damage caused by a vehicle of the State, a wilaya, a commune or a public administrative body belong to the ordinary courts. | partly: The TEXT does not say that these claims belong to the ordinary courts.

Claims to recognise filiation or to deny paternity are brought before the court of the defendant's domicile. | partly: For recognition of filiation, the TEXT specifies «لشخص مجهول النسب»; it does not state the rule for recognition claims generally.
